docs: Confirms the off-chain work event and starts the escrow deadline.
The arbitrator is expected to be the account used by the GitHub webhook service.
messages.label: complete_work

docs: Called by the Client to pay the Provider, or by the Arbitrator to settle a dispute in favor of the Provider.
messages.label: release_payment

docs: Called by the Client after the deadline, or by the Arbitrator to settle a dispute in favor of the Client.
messages.label: refund_client

docs: Can be triggered by either the client or the provider if negotiations break down.
This freezes normal operations and passes absolute judgment control to the arbitrator.
messages.label: raise_dispute
